where with more than the typical number of channels it's
too large and overflows
column2: and userspace can't get any of

column1: the information at all.
To address this (in a way that doesn't require making all
messages bigger) allow userspace to specify that it can
deal with wiphy information split across multiple parts
of the dump
column2: and if it can split up the data. This also

column1: splits up each channel separately so an arbitrary number
of channels can be supported.

column2: since GET_WIPHY has the same problem

column1: support for filtering the wiphy dump and get information
for a single wiphy only

device.

add a global nl80211 feature set and include a bit for
this behaviour in it.
